\# Adds archiving and trial end behavior settings to Trial Offers

\## What’s new

Adds the following capabilities and updates to \[Trial Offers\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/product-catalog/trial-offer.md?api-version=2026-09-30.preview):

\- Archive a trial offer
\- Support for missing payment method behavior at trial end
\- Renames \`name\` to \`nickname\`
\- Makes \`end\_behavior.transition\` optional

You can now archive a trial offer by setting its \[active\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/product-catalog/trial-offer/object.md?api-version=2026-09-30.preview#product\_catalog\_trial\_offer\_object-active) parameter to \`false\` when you \[create\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/product-catalog/trial-offer/create.md?api-version=2026-09-30.preview) or \[update\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/product-catalog/trial-offer/update.md?api-version=2026-09-30.preview) it. Archived offers can’t be attached to new subscription items, but existing subscriptions continue using the trial offer until their trial ends.

At trial end, trial offers now support the \[missing payment method\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions/create.md?api-version=2026-09-30.preview#create\_subscription-trial\_settings-end\_behavior-missing\_payment\_method) setting when a free or paid trial offer ends. Previously, these options were available only for subscription-level free trials. You can create an invoice, pause the subscription, or cancel it if the customer doesn’t have a payment method. You can also use the \[billing\_cycle\_anchor\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions/create.md?api-version=2026-09-30.preview#create\_subscription-trial\_settings-end\_behavior-billing\_cycle\_anchor) setting to start a new billing period when a trial ends or to preserve the subscription’s existing billing cycle and create a prorated post-trial period.

The \[name\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/product-catalog/trial-offer/object.md?api-version=2026-08-26.preview#product\_catalog\_trial\_offer\_object-name) parameter has been renamed to \[nickname\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/product-catalog/trial-offer/object.md?api-version=2026-09-30.preview#product\_catalog\_trial\_offer\_object-nickname). A nickname is an internal label for organizing trial offers and isn’t shown to customers.

The \[transition\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/product-catalog/trial-offer/object.md?api-version=2026-09-30.preview#product\_catalog\_trial\_offer\_object-end\_behavior-transition) property on the \[end\_behavior\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/product-catalog/trial-offer/object.md?api-version=2026-09-30.preview#product\_catalog\_trial\_offer\_object-end\_behavior) hash is now optional. Use \[end\_behavior.type\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/product-catalog/trial-offer/create.md?api-version=2026-09-30.preview#create\_product\_catalog\_trial\_offer-end\_behavior-type) to determine the trial offer’s end behavior.

\## Why is this a breaking change?

The \`name\` parameter and response property are removed and replaced with \`nickname\`.

\`end\_behavior.transition\` is no longer returned on all responses. Update your code to use \`end\_behavior.type\` instead.

\## Impact

You can now archive trial offers, giving you a way to retire outdated trial offers without interrupting customers who are already using them.

Trial offers now use the same \[missing payment method\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions/create.md?api-version=2026-09-30.preview#create\_subscription-trial\_settings-end\_behavior-missing\_payment\_method) behavior as \[free trials\](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/trials/free-trials.md). When a trial offer ends without a payment method, use \`create\_invoice\` to continue with invoice collection, \`pause\` to stop billing until you resume the subscription, or \`cancel\` to end the subscription. These settings apply when a trial ends naturally or if you end a trial early by changing or removing the trialing item. By default, a trial offer resets the subscription’s billing cycle anchor when the trial ends. Set \`billing\_cycle\_anchor=unchanged\` when you want the subscription to retain its existing billing date and bill the period after the trial as a proration.

See \[Configure trial offers on subscriptions\](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/trials.md) for setup and migration guidance.

entries.quote: You can now archive a trial offer by setting its active parameter to false when you create or update it. Archived offers can’t be attached to new subscription items, but existing subscriptions continue using the trial offer until their trial ends. The name parameter has been renamed to nickname. Subscription.trial_settings.end_behavior.billing_cycle_anchor, SubscriptionItem.current_trial are now required.
